title: Write a Commit History That Makes Sense
description: Three independent changes need to be made to a utility file. Keep each logical change in its own commit so the resulting history is easy to review and maintain.
objective: Create three separate commits in the correct order, with each commit containing only its corresponding logical change.
whatToDo: Keep each logical change in its own commit and finish with a clean working tree.
hints: Start by examining utils.py and identify the three independent changes that need to be made.
Treat each change as its own logical unit. Before committing, inspect what has changed so unrelated work does not get included.
The final history should make it easy to understand, review, or revert each change independently.

intro.message: Sarah wants this history to be easy to review. There are three separate changes waiting in utils.py, and each one should have a clear place in the history.

success.message: This is exactly the kind of history I like reviewing. Each change has its own boundary, the order makes sense, and the repository is clean.

failure.message: The history isn't quite right yet. Look at how the changes are grouped and make sure each logical change can stand on its own.
